usage.outputShape: body.phone_number (the provisioned E.164 number), body.expires_at (ISO lease expiry), body.chain, body.message
quirks: Body must be ONLY {"country":"US"} — sending a "type" key returns 400 'Invalid request body' (unrecognized_keys) and does NOT charge; strip extra keys before paying.
Pre-payment validation: invalid bodies 400 with paid:false (no money lost), so schema can be probed safely before a valid body triggers the $5 charge.
Outward/irreversible: a real US local number is provisioned and billed $5.00 USDC on Base on success.
Number is leased for 30 days (see expires_at); intended for use as the 'from' caller ID in voice calls.
usage.guide: Send POST to https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/phone/numbers/buy with x402 payment and a JSON body containing only {"country":"US"}. Do not include a "type" or other extra key or you get a 400 (no charge). On success (200) you pay $5.00 USDC on Base and the response returns body.phone_number (the provisioned E.164 number) plus body.expires_at (30-day lease). Use body.phone_number as the 'from' caller ID for outbound voice calls. This is an irreversible paid provisioning action — confirm with the user before calling.
